This ruling was finally made after that precise question came up:

Subject: VTES Rules Team Rulings July 97
Message-ID: <33B811...@regency.wizards.com>

12) Minions controlled by the same player cannot enter combat with
each other. If a card effect or rule would put those minions into
combat, this part of the effect or rule is simply ignored.
